# Assessment Supplementary Documents

This directory contains supplementary architecture and application fact documents generated alongside the versioned assessment report.

- [Architecture diagram](architecture-diagram.md) — Application layers, technologies, and component relationships.
- [Dependency map](dependency-map.md) — Declared application and test dependencies, grouped by purpose.
- [API and service contracts](api-service-contracts.md) — Web request handlers, contracts, and communication patterns.
- [Data architecture](data-architecture.md) — Database configuration, photo entity, persistence, and data ownership.
- [Configuration inventory](configuration-inventory.md) — Configuration sources, runtime profiles, settings, secrets, and framework versions.
- [Business workflows](business-workflows.md) — Photo upload, browsing, deletion, and associated business rules.
